id./param/scenario/cs/b_080_cs_020.pack|cs_: "...Hm. So, as rumored, everyone had the same dream. A warrior lamenting his bitterness...
"He was desperately asking for help. I'd like to help, but without a clue, we're stuck.
"...The crest on that warrior's armor was surely Dundrasil's, our homeland's.
"Come to think of it, I wonder what became of Dundrasil after darkness covered the world. Shall we go look?"
